physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Pleiades is recorded: it is an extended nebula, and its package frames it at 3.539 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: Pinned common ICRS image-frame origin derived from registered observations; adopted display centre, not a measured nebular centroid. (https://github.com/layoutit/css.earth/blob/main/labs/nebula/models/m45/processing-observations.json); catalogue reference m45-registered-frame
sources.distance: Melis et al. (2014), A VLBI Resolution of the Pleiades Distance Controversy (https://arxiv.org/pdf/1408.6544); catalogue reference melis-2014: 136.2 pc (-1.2/+1.2); Adopted VLBI stellar-cluster distance from Melis et al. (2014), main text and Table 1; not a measured distance to each dust filament.
sources.properMotion: Zero: the nebula is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
